_comment_seed: Third corpus pass. A NEW seed is required: reusing an earlier seed reproduces that pass's sentences even when sentence_id differs.
_comment_start: One past the highest sentence_id in the renumbered corpora (46,707,707). The first two passes were renumbered to one id per line, so this pass continues that global sequence.
_comment_layout: One consecutive sentence_id per emitted line, sentence grouping kept in group_id, matching out_renumbered and out2_renumbered.
